This company is the absolute worst when it comes to delivering on what the players want.

As of writing this, VRChat has acknowledged that 95% of the player-base wants SOME way to identify AI generated or assisted content on their platform. Despite this, they've decided to forego ANY labelling strategy and will instead do **nothing** about it.

Even beyond this spat, VRChat has consistently disrespected its users.

I love this game, I love the people in it, I truly do.

But the current transparently pro-AI pivot the platform is going through makes it impossible for me to recommend.
It's not just tone-deaf and incredibly short sighted for a platform built on user-created content to go in this direction, but the way how the information is being communicated itself is borderline abusive.

Feedback forms filled with biased questionaire layout clearly designed to basically gerrymander the results into the pre-decided outcome, and when that still fails (with 95% of answers demanding an AI labelling feature) still doubling down on not creating one.

In case someone from the decision making team actually reads these comments: The AI filter *is* the compromise. It is the *bare minimum* of what people would find acceptable, with the alternative being an outright ban of AI. And if you can't deliver that compromise, the only alternative that remains is cancelling VRC+ subscriptions and moving on to resonite or something else.

"Imagine a world where anything is possible... In VRChat there is something around every corner that will delight, thanks to the power of true user generated content."

The 'About this game' section has some nice lies, the decisions by the devs have been completely deaf to the PC player base. They like to tout things about user generated content but have taken every opportunity to step on the nuts of the modding scene. This isn't some competitive tournament shooter, it's a game for people to socialize in a sandbox. Enabling EasyAntiCheat only benefits the client monkeys and those who have avatars with crashing capabilities. Clients WILL get around EAC. The only people this with harm are those who use QOL mods to make the game actually enjoyable and people not wanting to be crashed by issues/exploits that have been in this game for quite possibly YEARS. The modders of your game are some of the biggest supporters of your game, and yet you toss away their enthusiasm and hard work to make it just that much better. What a joke. They do not care about feedback. Go look at the recent events and announcements page, they removed your ability to comment after backlash on VRC+. They just don't care. And I don't care to support this anymore.

very good chatting social "network" that can be used both in VR and in nonVR mode.
Talking to random people can get boring really fast and there is basically nothing to do other than just talk and change your avatar. RecRoom is a popular competitor but in my opinion more ugly and has significantly less customization options. VRChat doesn't really do playable interactive games very well, unlike RecRoom, but the communication and customizations features are just leagues better.

One major issue is:
it uses easy anticheat
EAC does not benefit the game significantly enough to warrant hurting players, especially people with physical issues such as mobility or hearing. Players can no longer use mods to enhance the game and help counter such disabilities or just to include QOL features.

other than that it's a pretty neat little social game but theres not much to do other than talk, and it also really sucks without VR since it was basically built for it.
